title: The main boulevard, Saigon — "probably taking a picture of the '65 Chevy"
description: A long colonial block with balustraded balconies and shuttered windows behind big tamarind trees, market stalls under awnings at the kerb, a doctor's shingle and shop signs on the façade, and a row of parked cars including a big two-tone American sedan and, at right, a Saigon taxi. "This must be Saigon due to the Saigon Taxi on the right. I was probably taking a picture of the 65 Chevy. This is probably the main boulevard."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0085-c18308086.json). A 1965 Chevrolet on a Saigon street is itself a dating floor for the frame — the model year reached showrooms in the autumn of 1964 — if his identification of the car is right; a machine-shop man's eye for a Chevrolet is worth more than most. The survey read a street number and a physician's name on the signs and suggested the block is on Lê Lợi; a hypothesis awaiting a period directory, not adopted.
